'''Spore/B stun grenades''' were [[black]], ovoid [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]] manufactured by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]] that released microscopic [[Bothan stun spore]]s capable of incapacitating targets. These were extensively used by special forces, particularly Bothan spies. The [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] used it with the [[CSPL-12 projectile launcher/Legends|CSPL-12]] [[Projectile launcher/Legends|projectile launcher]].
